name: Witch
source:
A strange girl. Luna and Corona know her and are always on guard when shes around. When Luna and Corona's friends are around, they pretend they don't know one another.

For some reason Luna and Corona seem to want nothing to do with her and warn her to "Don't try to do anything" around them or their friends.
